judgements.referenceQuote: On 3 May 2016, Ban Ki-moon announced that the post of executive director of UNEP would be taken over by Erik Solheim in June 2016.
In November 2018, Guterres also appointed Steiner to co-chair (alongside Maria Ramos) the United Nations Task Force on Digital Financing of Sustainable Development Goals.

Following his departure from UNDP in 2025, Steiner returned to the Oxford Martin School, University of Oxford as a senior fellow.[16] He subsequently established the Security Futures Lab, a research and policy platform with its hub at the Oxford Martin School, designed to treat climate change, health security, societal resilience, algorithmic security and geopolitical fragmentation as interconnected dimensions of a single risk system rather than separate policy domains.
